subject: after-hours calls at titan air
body: Hi there - saw Titan Air advertises 24/7 emergency HVAC, but the after-hours line rang to voicemail when I tried it. That's usually where the high-intent jobs leak out. I build an AI voice agent that answers those calls, books the job, and texts the caller back. Want to hear it live? Call Jack, my HVAC demo, at +1 555 010 1234 - it's a real agent, not a recording.
personalization_evidence: 24/7 emergency advertised but after-hours line -> voicemail (contact page)
unverified_assumptions: No owner name found on site, so the open uses no first name by design.
